item_weight_check.name: item_weight_check
item_weight_check.value: ("item"."unit" = 'PIECE' and "item"."standard_weight_kg" is not null and "item"."standard_weight_kg" > 0) or ("item"."unit" = 'KG' and "item"."standard_weight_kg" is null)

stock_adjustment_line_condition_check.name: stock_adjustment_line_condition_check
stock_adjustment_line_condition_check.value: "stock_adjustment_line"."condition" in ('NEW', 'GOOD', 'NEEDS_REPAIR', 'SCRAP') and ("stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" is null or "stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" in ('NEW', 'GOOD', 'NEEDS_REPAIR', 'SCRAP'))

stock_adjustment_line_shape_check.name: stock_adjustment_line_shape_check
stock_adjustment_line_shape_check.value:
("stock_adjustment_line"."line_type" = 'QUANTITY' and "stock_adjustment_line"."quantity" <> 0 and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" is null and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_location_id" is null)
        or ("stock_adjustment_line"."line_type" = 'CONDITION' and "stock_adjustment_line"."quantity" > 0 and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" is not null and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" <> "stock_adjustment_line"."condition" and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_location_id" is null)
        or ("stock_adjustment_line"."line_type" = 'LOCATION' and "stock_adjustment_line"."quantity" > 0 and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_location_id" is not null and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_location_id" <> "stock_adjustment_line"."location_id" and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" is null)
        or ("stock_adjustment_line"."line_type" = 'OPENING' and "stock_adjustment_line"."quantity" > 0 and "stock_adjustment_line"."unit_cost" is not null and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" is null and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_location_id" is null)
